title: RiskyPy: Toward Model-Calibrated Prompt Generation for Joint Security and Functionality Evaluation of LLM-Generated Code
title_zh: RiskyPy：面向大语言模型生成代码的安全性与功能性联合评估的模型校准提示词生成

paragraphs.en: RiskyPy自动生成与模型能力校准的Python安全性代码生成数据集，支持安全性与功能性联合评估。 Evaluating approaches that improve the security of LLM code generation requires datasets that jointly assess security and functionality and remain adapted to the capabilities of the models being studied. However, existing benchmarks are costly to produce and are generally not calibrated to a chosen range of model capabilities. We introduce RiskyPy, an automated pipeline that generates security-oriented code-generation datasets calibrated to model proficiency using functionality and vulnerability canaries. We instantiate RiskyPy for Python using domains covering 18 CWEs from the 2025 CWE Top 25, producing 101 prompts. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Seed-Coder-8B show that the generated tasks remain functionally accessible, with 57-72% of prompts yielding functional code, while only 5-10% of generations are free of Bandit findings, leaving room for joint evaluation of security and functionality of security improvement approaches.
paragraphs.zh: RiskyPy是一个自动生成并与模型能力校准的Python安全代码生成数据集，支持安全性与功能性的联合评估。评估能够提升大语言模型代码生成安全性的方法，需要既能联合衡量安全性与功能性、又能与研究模型的能力保持适配的数据集。 然而，现有基准的构建成本高昂，且通常无法针对所选的模型能力范围进行校准。 我们提出了RiskyPy，这是一个自动化流水线，利用功能性与漏洞金丝雀（canary）生成与模型熟练程度相校准的面向安全的代码生成数据集。 我们针对Python实例化了RiskyPy，使用涵盖2025年CWE Top 25中18个CWE的领域，共生成101个提示。 在Qwen3-4B和Seed-Coder-8B上的实验表明，所生成的任务在功能上仍然可达，57–72%的提示能产出功能正常的代码，而仅有5–10%的生成结果没有Bandit发现，这为安全改进方法的安全性与功能性联合评估留下了空间。
